title: Great day to see the Pyrenees mountains!

title: Rod gave detailed...
text: Rod gave detailed explanation about everything. He was very knowledgeable about the subject. If he didn’t have an answer he would look into it. He got to know me about likes and dislikes to shape the tour to something I would enjoy. Great tour.
author: Effie_E

title: A great day trip out to the Pyrenees
text: A great personal tour, with a fantastic guide that was quite insightful! An awesome day trip if you are looking to get out of the city for a day and get to the mountains! We were very lucky to have a small but diverse group and amazing weather to take in the views
author: Pierre M

title: Awesome day trip
text: The trip was wonderful, and the itinerary was very well planned. The entire company team was very kind and informative. Our guide, Pablo, in particular, was a great person with a great sense of humor. He made us feel comfortable during the trip and suggested beautiful places to visit, both during the excursion and in Barcelona in general.
author: 952mariosa

title: Amazing Guided Tour with Pablo – Highly Recommend!
text:
